label: CRS326-24S+2Q+RM
description: MikroTik CRS326-24S+2Q+RM - 24x 10G SFP+ cages, 2x 40G QSFP+ cages and 1x 100M management port (eth1), RouterOS or SwOS.
notes: MikroTik spec table, rows Fiber 'SFP+ ports: 24' and 'Number of 40G QSFP+ ports: 2'; the product text states "two 40 Gbps QSFP+ ports and twenty four 10 Gbps SFP+ ports". Every front-panel data port is a cage, so the 24-port template declares connector sfp+ and the two 40G ports declare qsfp+. eth1 is the 100M management port, an RJ45 socket. No speedCaps are declared on the SFP+ group: this page does not state a 1G rate for those cages (unlike the CRS326-24G pages, which name 1.25G explicitly), so the cages are left at their stated 10G rather than widened on inference. Source: https://mikrotik.com/product/crs326_24s_2q_rm
